hotels.title: Great Ocean Road Escape: Torquay Coastal Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Wind your way along the coast of Victoria to this seaside haven, elegantly perched on the northern headland of Torquay, the Great Ocean Road's starting point. Spend your days exploring one of Australia's most famed stretches of coastline, home to the iconic surfing haven of Bells Beach and the Australian National Surfing Museum. After busy days, plunge into the expansive 25-metre heated indoor pool or work out in the fully equipped gym. Stretch out with a yoga class, try your hand at a round of tennis or pull up a pew at the bar and savour your favourite drink. The Sands Torquay is perched on an 18-hole championship golf course designed by former Australian professional golfer Stuart Appleby. Golfers will be instantly impressed by the immaculately groomed fairway set against a striking coastal backdrop. There's also plenty to keep their travelling companions and little ones busy. Walk along the adjacent Whites Beach, take the short drive into Torquay township for boutiques and gourmet bites, marvel at the wonders of Bells Beach or travel a little further afield to the broader wonders of the Great Ocean Road, including the spectacular Twelve Apostles.

hotels.title: Elegant Great Ocean Road Torquay Escape Steps from Zeally Bay Beach with Indoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Experience the sheer coastal bliss of Victoria's picturesque Surf Coast with an escape to this stylish retreat in Torquay, ideally sitting across Zeally Bay Beach. The perfect launchpad for exploring the unrivalled beauty of the Great Ocean Road, this resort offers a blend of modern comfort with classic charms, featuring spacious, well-appointed accommodations to ensure utmost relaxation. Take a dip in the heated indoor pool, pamper with treatments at the outdoor spa, play tennis or indulge in culinary delights at the onsite bar and cafe. From surf lessons, vibrant dining and farmers markets, to reef walks and fishing charters, you'll be perfectly placed to take advantage of everything the Great Ocean Road has to offer.
